verdicts.evidence: Unreachable equality: the comparison sits behind `if (x !== y)` on the same two values, so `x < y` and `x <= y` can only disagree when x === y, which the guard has already excluded. The ternary returns the same -1/1 for every input that reaches it. Measured 2026-09-25: compareCitations is pinned pairwise in both argument orders (test/unit/citations.test.js), identical under the mutant.
